symbolDescription: A marker placed at a coordinate, carrying any payload you attach.

optionDescriptions.lat: Latitude in degrees, positive north, from -90 to 90.
optionDescriptions.lng: Longitude in degrees, positive east, from -180 to 180.
optionDescriptions.id: Stable, unique identifier. Connections refer to pins by it.
optionDescriptions.data: Arbitrary consumer payload. Never cloned, never mutated, passed through as-is.
